data.one_liner: Calculates Material Design responsive layout grid properties based on current screen size.
data.what_it_does: Calculates standard Material Design responsive layout grid properties including columns, gutters, and margins. Identifies device classifications and window sizes using either LayoutConstraints or MediaQuery.
use_when: You want to follow Material Design responsive layout guidelines
You need standard column counts, gutters, and margins based on screen width
You want a simple builder widget or manual calculations for adaptive layouts
avoid_when: You require complex custom breakpoint configurations outside of Material Design standards
You are using a different responsive framework that handles scaling entirely
strengths: Implements standard Material Design responsive layout grid system seamlessly
Supports both MediaQuery and BoxConstraints usage
weaknesses: Limited to predefined Material Design breakpoints and columns
Does not provide automated scaling or font resizing features

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you need advanced auto-scaling, text scaling, and a comprehensive suite of responsive layout tools.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it for widget-based screen type detection (mobile, tablet, desktop) and custom sizing queries.
